steps.text: Open the flyPad (Ctrl+0 shows the view) and go to the Ground page.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.9 Powering Down, section '2. Disembarking Passengers and Baggage' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/09_powering-down/)

steps.text: Press Connect Jet Bridge. Call the baggage truck.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.9 Powering Down, section '2. Disembarking Passengers and Baggage' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/09_powering-down/); flyPad Ground, section 'Ground Service' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/aircraft/common/flypados3/ground/)
steps.why: You can also use the MSFS built-in ATC or add-on tools for the ground services. In the real aircraft the ground services start by themselves when you park.

steps.text: On the Payload page press Deboard Now (or the deboarding button).
steps.source: flyPad Ground, section 'Payload Page: Deboard Now' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/aircraft/common/flypados3/ground/)
steps.why: You do not shut the aircraft down before all passengers and crew have left.

sd_turnq.title: Next flight
sd_turnq.text: Will the aircraft fly again soon (turnaround)?
sd_turnq.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.9 Powering Down, section 'Preface' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/09_powering-down/)

sd_turn.title: Turnaround
sd_turn.text: For a turnaround you do not switch certain systems off and you start the preparation again at some point. The beginner guide only says that the procedure is a little different and does not list it, so use the Power up topic from the point you need.
sd_turn.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.9 Powering Down, section 'Preface' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/09_powering-down/)

sd_secure.title: Securing the aircraft
sd_secure.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.9 Powering Down, section '3. Securing the Aircraft' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/09_powering-down/); FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Securing the Aircraft' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)

steps.text: Set the parking brake ON.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.9 Powering Down, section '3. Securing the Aircraft: PARKING BRAKE ON' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/09_powering-down/)
steps.why: The SOP recommends keeping it on to reduce hydraulic leaks.

steps.text: Set the crew oxygen supply OFF.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.9 Powering Down, section '3. Securing the Aircraft: OXYGEN CREW SUPPLY OFF' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/09_powering-down/)

steps.text: Set the ADIRS 1, 2 and 3 OFF.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.9 Powering Down, section '3. Securing the Aircraft: ADIRS (1+2+3) OFF' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/09_powering-down/)
steps.why: Wait 10 seconds before you turn the electrical supply OFF so the system remembers the last data (SOP). Do not turn the ADIRS off between turnarounds above 70 degrees north, to avoid long alignment times.

steps.text: Switch all exterior lights OFF.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.9 Powering Down, section '3. Securing the Aircraft: EXTERIOR LIGHTS OFF' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/09_powering-down/)

steps.text: Set the APU BLEED OFF.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.9 Powering Down, section '3. Securing the Aircraft: APU BLEED OFF' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/09_powering-down/)

steps.text: Set the external power as required.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.9 Powering Down, section '3. Securing the Aircraft: EXTERNAL POWER OFF' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/09_powering-down/); FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Securing the Aircraft, External power' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)
steps.why: The aircraft needs at least two external power units to supply the whole network. The SOP says to check that the APU is below 50 % and, if it is not, to use a third external power unit or keep the APU. To lower the load you can turn CABIN FANS and COOLG OFF, but turn them ON again as soon as possible.

steps.text: Switch the APU master OFF, once all passengers have left.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.9 Powering Down, section '3. Securing the Aircraft: AUXILIARY POWER UNIT MASTER SWITCH OFF' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/09_powering-down/); FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Securing the Aircraft, Auxiliary Power Unit' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)

steps.text: Set the emergency exit lights OFF and NO SMOKING OFF.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.9 Powering Down, section '3. Securing the Aircraft: EMERGENCY EXIT LIGHTS OFF; NO SMOKING OFF' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/09_powering-down/)
steps.why: This saves the battery charge.

steps.text: Complete the Securing the Aircraft checklist.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.9 Powering Down, section '3. Securing the Aircraft: SECURING THE AIRCRAFT CHECKLIST COMPLETE' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/09_powering-down/)
steps.where: Press C/L on the ECAM control panel (pedestal). The checklist shows on the EWD.
steps.why: Move through the items with UP and DOWN and tick an item with the check-mark button. Some items are ticked by the aircraft itself (for example the beacon).

steps.text: Switch all batteries OFF (BAT 1, ESS, BAT 2, APU).
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.9 Powering Down, section '3. Securing the Aircraft: ALL BATT OFF' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/09_powering-down/); FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Securing the Aircraft, Battery 1, Essential, Battery 2, and APU Battery' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)
steps.why: Wait until the APU flap is closed before you switch the APU battery off. The aircraft is then cold and dark.

sd_end.title: Cold and dark
sd_end.text: The aircraft is secured and back to the cold and dark state.
sd_end.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.9 Powering Down, section '3. Securing the Aircraft' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/09_powering-down/)

ai_gnd.title: Anti-ice on the ground
ai_gnd.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.4 Engine Start and Taxi, section 'After Engine Start: ENGINE ANTI_ICE' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/04_engine-start-taxi/); FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'After Start, Engine Anti-Ice system' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf); A380X Pilot Briefing, Anti Ice Panel (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/ovhd/anti-ice/)

steps.text: Switch the engine anti-ice ON when icing is expected, or when there is standing water, slush, ice or snow on the taxiway or runway and the outside air temperature is below 10 degrees C.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.4 Engine Start and Taxi, section 'After Engine Start: ENGINE ANTI_ICE AS REQUIRED' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/04_engine-start-taxi/)
steps.why: With engine anti-ice on, the ground idle thrust is higher.

check.code: (A:ENG ANTI ICE:1, Bool) (A:ENG ANTI ICE:2, Bool) + (A:ENG ANTI ICE:3, Bool) + (A:ENG ANTI ICE:4, Bool) +

steps.text: Enter the anti-ice setting on the T.O PERF page (for example ENG ONLY).
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'Performance: Take Off Performance' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/)

steps.text: If you taxi in icing conditions, wait with the flaps until the runway holding point.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'After Start, Flaps' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)
steps.why: That keeps the flap mechanism clean.

steps.text: Do the ice-shedding run-up: at least every 30 minutes of taxi time and before take-off, set the parking brake ON and raise the thrust to 60 % N1 on two symmetrical engines, then on the other two.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'After Start, Engine Anti-Ice system' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)
steps.warn: If the aircraft starts to move, stop the run-up. When it is stationary again, repeat it with one engine at a time.

steps.text: The wing anti-ice: on the ground the valves open for 30 s, then are inhibited for 10 min while the aircraft is not in flight.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Anti Ice Panel, section 'WING anti-ice' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/ovhd/anti-ice/)
steps.why: If you do not switch it off, the ON light stays on even though the valves are closed. The valves open again after the take-off thrust reduction. Do not use the APU bleed if the wing anti-ice is used for take-off (SOP).

ai_air.title: Anti-ice in flight
ai_air.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'After Takeoff / Climb / Descent Preparation, Anti-Ice protection' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf); A380X Pilot Briefing, Anti Ice Panel (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/ovhd/anti-ice/)

steps.text: Switch the engine anti-ice ON when icing conditions are expected and the total air temperature is at or below 10 degrees C.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'After Takeoff, Anti-Ice protection' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)
steps.why: In the climb the SOP says to switch it on when the aircraft meets icing conditions, unless the static air temperature is below -40 degrees C.

check.code: (A:ENG ANTI ICE:1, Bool) (A:ENG ANTI ICE:2, Bool) + (A:ENG ANTI ICE:3, Bool) + (A:ENG ANTI ICE:4, Bool) +

steps.text: Set the wing anti-ice as required.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Anti Ice Panel, section 'WING anti-ice' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/ovhd/anti-ice/)
steps.why: The ECAM shows the WING A-ICE memo. Engine anti-ice shows ENG A-ICE.

steps.text: Keep PROBE & WINDOW HEAT at AUTO.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Overhead Panel, Probe & window heat' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)
steps.why: Set it to ON only in cold weather conditions.

steps.text: In the descent, expect a shallower descent path with the anti-ice on.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Descent Preparation, Anti-Ice protection' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)
steps.why: With the engines at idle, the anti-ice reduces the descent path angle.

rd_what.title: Radios

choices.label: Tune or use a VHF radio (RMP)
VOR / ADF information on the ND

rd_what.help: The A380X radio management panels (RMP) only work for VHF voice and the squawk code for now.
rd_what.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Radio Management Panel, section 'Usage' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/rmp/)

rd_vhf.title: VHF radio
rd_vhf.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Radio Management Panel, section 'Usage' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/rmp/)

steps.text: Turn the RMP BRT/OFF knob on.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, RMP, section 'BRT/OFF KNOB' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/rmp/)
steps.where: Pedestal, RMP 1 (captain), RMP 2 (first officer) or RMP 3.
steps.why: Status light: green means the RMP is off in standby, red means failed, no light means on.

steps.text: Press the VHF transmission key you want (VHF 1, 2 or 3). It lights green.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, RMP, section 'VHF TRANSMISSION KEYS' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/rmp/)
steps.why: Only one means of communication can be in transmission mode at a time on each RMP. The SOP suggests VHF 1 for the ATC and emergency frequencies, VHF 2 for the ATIS, VHF 3 for ACARS.

steps.text: Enter the frequency with the numeric keys and validate it with the line select / dialling keys beside it.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, RMP, section 'NUMERIC KEYS; LINE SELECTION KEYS; ACTIVATION/DIALING KEYS' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/rmp/)
steps.why: The VHF page shows the active frequency and the standby frequency. The CLR key clears the last digit; hold it to clear all digits. The RMPs share their frequencies.

steps.text: Use the VHF reception knob to set the volume.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, RMP, section 'VHF RECEPTION KNOBS' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/rmp/)
steps.why: When it is lit and pulled out, turning it changes the headset volume.

steps.text: With VATSIM vPilot, remember its limits.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, RMP, section 'Usage: VATSIM vPilot' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/rmp/)
steps.warn: vPilot supports only 2 RMPs and not the volume control. VHF1 / COM1 works well, but VHF2 / COM2 only works if you turn VHF3 / COM3 receive on.

rd_sqk.title: Squawk code
rd_sqk.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.2 Cockpit Preparation, section 'Pedestal: MFD SURVEILLANCE DEFAULT SETTINGS' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/02_cockpit-preparation/); A380X Pilot Briefing, RMP, section 'Squawk Page' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/rmp/)

steps.text: On the MFD open the SURV page.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.2 Cockpit Preparation, section 'Pedestal: MFD Surveillance Default Settings' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/02_cockpit-preparation/)
steps.why: Check that the transponder is on AUTO.

steps.text: Click the SQWK field, type the code ATC gave you and press ENTER.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.2 Cockpit Preparation, section 'Pedestal: MFD Surveillance Default Settings' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/02_cockpit-preparation/)

steps.text: Click the AUTO button to activate the code.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.2 Cockpit Preparation, section 'Pedestal: MFD Surveillance Default Settings' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/02_cockpit-preparation/)

steps.text: Or use the Squawk page of the RMP to enter a squawk code quickly.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, RMP, section 'Squawk Page' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/rmp/)
steps.why: The transponder itself is otherwise managed on the MFD.

rd_tcas.title: TCAS
rd_tcas.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Surveillance Panel (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/surveillance/); FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Before Takeoff, TCAS' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)

steps.text: Use TA/RA for normal operations.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Before Takeoff, TCAS: TA ONLY or TA/RA' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)
steps.why: Use TA ONLY when TA/RA is not suitable, for example with converging or parallel runways. On the pedestal panel, the TA button not lit means TA/RA and TA ONLY lit means TA only. The pedestal surveillance panel is not yet fully implemented: use the MFD SURV page.

steps.text: Set the TCAS display mode: NORM, or ABV or BLW.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Surveillance Panel, section 'ABV and BLW pb' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/surveillance/)
steps.why: On the pedestal panel the ABV and BLW buttons are not lit for NORM.

steps.text: Press TRAF on the EFIS panel to see traffic on the ND.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.5 Takeoff, Climb and Cruise, section '1. Lineup: TRAF ON' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/05_takeoff-climb-cruise/)

rd_nav.title: VOR and ADF information
rd_nav.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, EFIS Panel, section 'ND Data Display pushbuttons' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/glareshield/efis/); FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Precision/Non Precision Approach' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)

steps.text: Press VOR1 or VOR2 (NAVAID 1 and 2) on the EFIS panel to show the selected VOR (or ADF) on the ND.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, EFIS Panel, section 'ND Data Display pushbuttons: VOR1 pb, VOR2 pb' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/glareshield/efis/)
steps.why: Enter the navaid on the POSITION / NAVAIDS page of the MFD first. Select a VOR/DME close to the airport to monitor the accuracy of the navigation (SOP).

steps.text: Press WPT, VORD, NDB, ARPT or CSTR to show those items on the ND.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, EFIS Panel, section 'ND Data Display pushbuttons' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/glareshield/efis/)

fw_what.title: Fuel and weight

choices.label: Load fuel and passengers (on the ground)
The centre of gravity is outside the limits

fw_what.source: A380X Fuel and Weight, section 'A380X Configuration' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/aircraft/a380x/feature-guides/loading-fuel-weight/)

fw_load.title: Load fuel and passengers
fw_load.source: A380X Fuel and Weight, section 'Loading Fuel and Weight; Loading Guide' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/aircraft/a380x/feature-guides/loading-fuel-weight/); flyPad Ground, section 'Fuel Page; Payload Page' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/aircraft/common/flypados3/ground/)

steps.text: Open the flyPad Ground page, Fuel. Type the quantity and press the play button.
steps.source: A380X Fuel and Weight, section 'Loading Fuel' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/aircraft/a380x/feature-guides/loading-fuel-weight/); flyPad Ground, section 'Fuel and De-Fuel' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/aircraft/common/flypados3/ground/)
steps.why: Fuel is loaded only through the flyPad; the MSFS Fuel and Weights window is blocked. The import button takes the fuel from a loaded SimBrief flight plan. After the engines start, only Instant is possible. If the play button is missing, see the Troubleshooting topic.

steps.text: Open the Payload page. Enter the passengers (or the ZFW) and the cargo. Start the boarding.
steps.source: A380X Fuel and Weight, section 'Passengers and Cargo Configuration; Boarding Passengers' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/aircraft/a380x/feature-guides/loading-fuel-weight/)
steps.why: Fill in only one of the passenger and ZFW fields: the other follows. The boarding speed (Instant, Fast, Real) is set in the flyPad settings. If you start on the runway, loading works only with the boarding time set to Instant.

steps.text: Read the ZFW, ZFWCG and gross weight when the loading is finished.
steps.source: A380X Fuel and Weight, section 'Passengers and Cargo Configuration: ZFW MAC %/CG and GW/GWCG' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/aircraft/a380x/feature-guides/loading-fuel-weight/)
steps.why: Use the switch to see GW and GWCG. They are used to set the trim for take-off (THS FOR).

steps.text: Enter them in the FMS (FUEL&LOAD page).
steps.source: A380X Fuel and Weight, section 'Cold and Dark Startup' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/aircraft/a380x/feature-guides/loading-fuel-weight/)
steps.warn: FUEL&LOAD must be completed before departure.

fw_limits.title: Weight limits
fw_limits.text: From the A380X Fuel and Weight page: operating empty weight (OEW) 300 007 kg; maximum zero fuel weight (MZFW) 373 000 kg; maximum take-off weight (MTOW) 510 000 kg; maximum landing weight (MLW) 395 000 kg. The maximum payload is the lowest of: MZFW minus OEW; MTOW minus OEW minus (fuel load minus taxi fuel); MLW minus OEW minus all the reserve and extra fuel. An acceptable take-off CG is between 28 % and 44 %. A passenger weighs 84 kg plus 20 kg of baggage by default. When you load by hand, the MLW and MTOW limits are not checked: you are responsible. SimBrief reduces the bags or passengers automatically.
fw_limits.source: A380X Fuel and Weight, section 'Weights; Passengers; Changing Default Weights Using SimBrief; Center of Gravity' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/aircraft/a380x/feature-guides/loading-fuel-weight/)

fw_cg.title: Centre of gravity outside the limits
fw_cg.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Loadsheet Verification' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf); A380X INOP systems, section 'ATA 28 Fuel' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/aircraft/a380x/inop/)

steps.text: Compare the loadsheet take-off CG with the GWCG on the ECAM, and check the ZFW / ZFWCG entered in the FMS.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Loadsheet Verification: LOADSHEET TOCG AND ECAM GWCG CROSSCHECK' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)
steps.why: If they differ by more than 1 %, check that the values are entered correctly. An abnormal fuel redistribution can also be the cause.

steps.text: If the ECAM GWCG is not within the limits: switch AUTO GND XFR ON on the maintenance panel.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Loadsheet Verification: AUTO GND XFR ON' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf); A380X Pilot Briefing, Maintenance Panel, section 'AUTO GND XFR pb-sw' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/ovhd/maintenance/)
steps.where: Overhead panel, maintenance panel, FUEL section.
steps.why: The ground transfer moves fuel to reach the target CG from the ZFW and ZFWCG in the FMS. All the transfer pumps must be ON. Wait for the ECAM message FUEL AUTO GND XFR COMPLETED, or stop it by hand when the CG is within the limits. Do not start it while the aircraft moves.
steps.warn: The INOP page says the automatic fuel transfer system is not fully implemented yet (for example AGT is off when two engines are on).

steps.text: Enter the take-off CG from the loadsheet as THS FOR on the T.O PERF page.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Loadsheet Verification: THS FOR INSERT T.O CG' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)

fw_panel.title: Fuel panel
fw_panel.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Fuel Panel, section 'Usage' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/ovhd/fuel/)

steps.text: Check the OUTR, MID and INR tank transfer buttons: AUTO means automatic transfers are available.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Fuel Panel, section 'INR(MID)(OUTR) TK XFR pb-sw' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/ovhd/fuel/)
steps.why: MAN transfers fuel by hand to the feed tanks. FAULT lights on these buttons come with ECAM alerts.

steps.text: Check the TRIM TK XFR button is AUTO.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Fuel Panel, section 'TRIM TK XFR pb-sw' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/ovhd/fuel/)

steps.text: Check that the TRIM TK FEED selector is AUTO.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.2 Cockpit Preparation, section 'Overhead Panel Center: TRIM TK FEED AUTO' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/02_cockpit-preparation/)
steps.why: ISOL stops the trim tank transfer; OPEN allows a gravity transfer.

steps.text: Check that the FEED TK main pump buttons are in AUTO.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Fuel Panel, section 'FEED TK 1(2)(3)(4) MAIN pb-sw' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/ovhd/fuel/)
steps.why: AUTO means the main pump runs. The standby pump comes on by itself when the main pump fails or is off.

fw_check.title: Fuel on board
fw_check.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Parking, Fuel quantity' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf); A380X Pilot Briefing, System Display (SD) (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/main-panel/sd/)

steps.text: Open the SD FUEL page, or read the fuel on board (FOB) in the middle section of the SD.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, SD, section 'Description' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/main-panel/sd/)
steps.where: SD; ECAM control panel, FUEL button.
steps.why: The middle section of the SD always shows the outside temperature, time, aircraft weight, CG and the fuel on board.

steps.text: Compare the fuel with the predicted fuel remaining of the FMS.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Parking, Fuel quantity: FUEL QUANTITY CHECK' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)
steps.why: The FMS shows the message CHECK MIN FUEL AT DEST and DEST EFOB BELOW MIN when the predicted fuel at the destination is below your minimum (release notes v0.14.0).

ab_what.title: What is happening?

choices.label: A problem during the take-off roll
The landing gear does not extend
ENG 2 / 3 REVERSER FAULT at the engine start
The autopilot or autothrust went off

ab_what.help: This topic only covers what the FlyByWire docs describe. The aircraft shows the detailed ECAM procedure on the EWD itself.

ab_ecam.title: ECAM alert
ab_ecam.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, ECAM Control Panel, section 'Usage' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/ecam-cp/); A380X Pilot Briefing, Glareshield Side Panels, section 'Attention Getters' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/glareshield/glare-side/)

steps.text: Press the MASTER WARN (red) or MASTER CAUT (amber) light to stop the sound.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Glareshield Side Panels, section 'Attention Getters' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/glareshield/glare-side/)
steps.why: MASTER WARN flashes for emergency situations, MASTER CAUT lights for abnormal situations. Pressing the light turns it off and stops the aural warning.

steps.text: Read the message and the procedure on the EWD, and do the actions.
steps.source: A380X release notes v0140, section 'Headline Features: FWS / ECAM & Checklists' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/release-notes/a380x/v0140/)
steps.why: The aircraft has 256 abnormal procedures, 246 of them sensed (detected by the aircraft). For sensed procedures only CLEAR can be used to complete items by hand (INOP page).

steps.text: Use UP and DOWN to move the blue box and the check-mark button to validate an item the ECAM cannot detect.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, ECAM Control Panel, section 'UP-ARROW, DOWN-ARROW and check mark' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/ecam-cp/)

steps.text: Press CLEAR to clear the lines shown by the vertical bar.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, ECAM Control Panel, section 'CLEAR' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/ecam-cp/)
steps.why: CLEAR does not stop an aural alert and does not end a not-sensed procedure.

steps.text: To bring back what you cleared, press RCL LAST (last clear), or hold RCL for 3 seconds (cleared or cancelled alerts).
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, ECAM Control Panel, section 'RCL LAST; EMER CANC' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/ecam-cp/); FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Aircraft Status Verification, Previous ECAM alerts' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)

steps.text: Press STS to see the STATUS page, and MORE for the further information.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, ECAM Control Panel, section 'STS; MORE' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/ecam-cp/)

steps.text: For not-sensed emergency or abnormal procedures, press ABN PROC.
steps.source: A380X release notes v0140, section 'Headline Features: Abnormal Non-Sensed Procedures added (e.g., EMER DESCENT, EMER EVAC)' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/release-notes/a380x/v0140/)
steps.warn: The ECAM Control Panel briefing page marks ABN PROC and EMER CANC as INOP; the release notes of v0.14.0 say the non-sensed procedures are implemented. Try it and trust what the aircraft shows.

ab_rto.title: Rejected take-off
ab_rto.text: What the A380X docs say: reject the take-off before 100 knots if a parameter looks abnormal, and above 100 knots it is a more serious decision. The pilot's hand stays on the thrust levers until V1. With the RTO autobrake armed (RTO ARM light and BRK RTO on the PFD), if the speed is above 72 knots the autobrake applies maximum braking when the thrust levers are set to idle; below 72 knots it does not act. Armed ground spoilers (or a reverser selection) extend automatically in a rejected take-off. The docs do not list further steps (reversers, announcements, evacuation), so follow your own training and the ECAM.
ab_rto.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Takeoff, At 100 knots; Taxi, Autobrake' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf); A380X Pilot Briefing, Speed Brake Panel, section 'Description' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/speed-brake/); A380X Beginner Guide ch.5 Takeoff, Climb and Cruise, section '2. Takeoff: At V1' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/05_takeoff-climb-cruise/)

ab_grav.title: Gravity gear extension
ab_grav.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Gravity Gear Panel, section 'Usage' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/main-panel/gravity-gear/)

steps.text: Remove both switch guards of the L/G GRVTY switch.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Gravity Gear Panel, section 'L/G GRVTY sw: Both switch-guards should be removed before the DOWN position is selected' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/main-panel/gravity-gear/)
steps.where: Main panel, L/G gravity gear panel (below the ISIS).

steps.text: Set the L/G GRVTY switch to DOWN.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Gravity Gear Panel, section 'DOWN POSITION' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/main-panel/gravity-gear/)
steps.where: Main panel, L/G gravity gear panel.
steps.why: The gear is extended by gravity. The switch stays in DOWN until you select another position.

steps.text: To use the normal gear lever again, select RESET and then OFF.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Gravity Gear Panel, section 'RESET POSITION' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/main-panel/gravity-gear/)
steps.why: The switch must be back to OFF before the gear lever extends or retracts the gear again.
steps.warn: A reset on the ground must be done by maintenance only (the body gear doors would collide with the forward wheels). A reset in flight is restricted to training when there is no gear system failure.

ab_spoil.title: Ground spoilers did not extend
ab_spoil.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Landing Roll, GROUND SPOILERS EXTENDED' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)

steps.text: Check that all thrust levers are at the IDLE detent.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Landing Roll, GROUND SPOILERS EXTENDED' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)
steps.why: The ground spoilers do not extend if two or more thrust levers are above IDLE.

steps.text: If the spoilers still do not extend, set both reversers to MAX REV and press the brake pedals.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Landing Roll, GROUND SPOILERS EXTENDED' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)
steps.why: The autobrake does not work when the ground spoilers are not extended.

ab_brake.title: Hot brakes
ab_brake.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Parking, Parking brake' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf); FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'After Landing, Brake temperature' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)

steps.text: Watch the brake temperatures on the SD WHEEL page.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'After Landing, Brake temperature: BRAKE TEMPERATURE MONITOR' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)
steps.why: Above 500 degrees C is high.

steps.text: Do not set the parking brake if a brake is above 500 degrees C.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Parking, Parking brake' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)
steps.why: Setting it with hot brakes and chocks in place also hinders the cooling of the brakes.

steps.text: If a BRAKE HOT alert shows, make sure the chocks are in place and release the parking brake.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Parking, Parking brake AS REQUIRED' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)

ab_fire.title: Fire warning
ab_fire.text: The docs describe the panels, not a full procedure. Follow the procedure the ECAM shows on the EWD. ENG FIRE button: pressed out (illuminated and open) it isolates all the systems from the engine, stops the aural fire warning and arms the extinguishing system. AGENT button: SQUIB means the bottle is armed; pressing it discharges the bottle and the SQUIB light goes off; DISCH means the bottle is discharged or empty. The APU FIRE button works in the same way for the APU: with the guard open and the button pushed out, the APU is isolated and the extinguisher is armed. The fire test button checks the detection and extinguishing system (see the Power up topic).
ab_fire.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Engine Fire Panel, section 'Usage' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/ovhd/eng-fire/); A380X Pilot Briefing, APU Fire Panel, section 'Usage' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/ovhd/apu-fire/)

ab_emer.title: Emergency descent and evacuation
ab_emer.text: The release notes of v0.14.0 list the not-sensed procedures EMER DESCENT and EMER EVAC, shown on the EWD through the ABN PROC button. For an evacuation, the COMMAND button on the overhead RCDR / EVAC panel (EVAC and ON) orders an evacuation whatever the CAPT / CAPT & PURS switch says: the EVACUATION ALERT message appears on the cabin panels and the evacuation horn sounds in the cabin. HORN OFF silences the horn in the cockpit. For a ditching, the DITCHING button of the CAB PRESS panel closes all valves below the flotation line. The docs give no further steps.
ab_emer.source: A380X release notes v0140, section 'Headline Features: FWS / ECAM & Checklists' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/release-notes/a380x/v0140/); A380X Pilot Briefing, Recording and Evacuation Panel, section 'Usage EVAC' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/ovhd/rcdr-evac/); A380X Pilot Briefing, Pressurization Panel, section 'DITCHING' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/ovhd/press/)

mf_what.title: FMS / MFD
mf_what.text: Which FMS page or function do you need?

choices.label: How the MFD, the cursor and the keyboard work
The KCCU keys (page shortcuts, CLR INFO)
PERF page (take-off, climb, cruise, descent, approach, go-around)
FMS messages and what they mean
Which pages exist and which are missing

mf_what.help: The FMS runs on the MFD (the Captain and the First Officer each have one), operated with the mouse and the keyboard, or with the KCCU on the pedestal. The A380X docs do not describe every page yet.
mf_what.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Multi-Function Display (MFD), section 'Description' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/main-panel/mfd/)

mf_basic.title: Operating the MFD
mf_basic.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Multi-Function Display (MFD), section 'Description; MFD Interaction' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/main-panel/mfd/); A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'Using Keyboard and Mouse' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/)

steps.text: Use your normal mouse and keyboard on the MFD.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Multi-Function Display (MFD), section 'MFD Interaction' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/main-panel/mfd/)
steps.why: The MFD shows the FMS pages (FMS), the ATC communication pages (ATCCOM), the surveillance pages (SURV) and the FCU backup (FCU BKUP). There is one MFD for the Captain and one for the First Officer; they can show different pages.

steps.text: Look for the mouse pointer: a yellow X with a dot in the middle.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'Using Keyboard and Mouse' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/)

steps.text: Click a grey box to press a button. A small downward triangle on a button means a drop-down menu opens.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'Using Keyboard and Mouse' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/)
steps.why: Grey text on a button means that the button is disabled. Tabs are buttons too.

steps.text: Click an input field. A blue typing cursor appears. Type the value and press ENTER to confirm it.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'Using Keyboard and Mouse' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/); A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'Init & Flight Plan Initialization' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/)
steps.why: Highlighted and selected buttons and fields have a blue border. A value is only taken when you press ENTER.

steps.text: Use the page selector at the top: the system (FMS, ATCCOM, SURV, FCU BKUP) and the page menus such as ACTIVE.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'Init & Flight Plan Initialization: Step 1' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/); A380X MFD common UI elements README (https://github.com/flybywiresim/aircraft/blob/master/fbw-a380x/src/systems/instruments/src/MFD/pages/common/README.md)
steps.why: For example, open INIT from the ACTIVE menu. The pages exist for the active flight plan and for the secondary flight plans SEC 1, 2 and 3 (README).

steps.text: Make sure the keyboard and the trackball of the KCCU are on: KBD and CCD switches ON.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Keyboard Cursor Control Unit (KCCU), section 'KBD sw; CCD sw' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/kccu/)
steps.why: KBD ON: the KCCU keyboard is active. CCD ON: the trackball is active.

steps.text: Mouse use depends on the MSFS cockpit interaction system. With the legacy system a simple click works.
steps.source: Known Issues (common to A32NX and A380X), section 'Cockpit Interaction System' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/aircraft/support/known-issues/known-issues-common/)

mf_kccu.title: KCCU keys
mf_kccu.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Keyboard Cursor Control Unit (KCCU), section 'Description; Usage' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/kccu/)

steps.text: INIT key: opens the ACTIVE / INIT page.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Keyboard Cursor Control Unit (KCCU), section 'INIT KEY' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/kccu/)

steps.text: F-PLN key: opens the top of the flight plan on ACTIVE / F-PLN.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Keyboard Cursor Control Unit (KCCU), section 'F-PLN KEY' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/kccu/)

steps.text: DEST key: opens the bottom of the primary flight plan on ACTIVE / F-PLN.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Keyboard Cursor Control Unit (KCCU), section 'DEST KEY' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/kccu/)

steps.text: PERF key: opens the ACTIVE / PERF page for the active flight phase.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Keyboard Cursor Control Unit (KCCU), section 'PERF KEY' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/kccu/)

steps.text: NAVAID key: opens the POSITION / NAVAIDS page.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Keyboard Cursor Control Unit (KCCU), section 'NAVAID KEY' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/kccu/)

steps.text: DIR key: opens the DIRECT TO page.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Keyboard Cursor Control Unit (KCCU), section 'DIR KEY' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/kccu/)

steps.text: SEC INDEX key: opens the SEC INDEX page.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Keyboard Cursor Control Unit (KCCU), section 'SEC INDEX KEY' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/kccu/)

steps.text: CLR INFO key: clears the message that is currently displayed in the FMS message area (also ATCCOM and SURV messages).
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Keyboard Cursor Control Unit (KCCU), section 'CLR INFO KEY' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/kccu/)

steps.text: Navigation keys: move the cursor to the display on the right or on the left.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Keyboard Cursor Control Unit (KCCU), section 'Navigation Keys' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/kccu/)
steps.why: Each key also moves the cursor back to the MFD if it was on another display. The ND key is not working.

steps.text: KBD and CCD switches: ON makes the keyboard and the trackball active.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Keyboard Cursor Control Unit (KCCU), section 'KBD sw; CCD sw' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/kccu/)

mf_init.title: INIT page
mf_init.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'FMS Initialization, Init & Flight Plan Initialization' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/); A380X SimBrief and Navigraph Integration, section 'Using the FMS and SimBrief Integration' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/aircraft/a380x/feature-guides/simbrief/)

steps.text: Open INIT: ACTIVE menu, INIT (or the INIT key, or the INIT button at the bottom of the F-PLN page).
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'Navaids: How and Where' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/)

steps.text: FLT NBR: the flight number. Click the field, type it, press ENTER.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'Flight Number' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/)

steps.text: FROM, TO, ALTN: departure, destination and (optional) alternate airport, as airport codes.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'From, To and Alternate Airports' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/)

steps.text: CI: the cost index. A high value means time matters more, a low value means fuel matters more.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'Cost Index' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/)

steps.text: CRZ FL: the cruise level (for example 240 for FL240). CRZ TEMP follows by itself but is not fully implemented.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'Cruise Level & Temp' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/)

steps.text: DEPARTURE button: opens the F-PLN / DEPARTURE page. NAVAIDS button: POSITION / NAVAIDS. FUEL&LOAD button: the FUEL&LOAD page. T.O PERF button: the take-off performance page.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'Departure; Navaids; Fuel & Payload; Performance: How and Where' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/)

steps.text: CPNY F-PLN REQUEST: asks SimBrief for the flight plan; then RECEIVED CPNY F-PLN with INSERT or CLEAR. CPNY WIND REQUEST: the same for the winds.
steps.source: A380X SimBrief and Navigraph Integration, section 'Request Data from SimBrief and Initialize Flight Plan; Wind Request' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/aircraft/a380x/feature-guides/simbrief/)

steps.text: Not available yet: RTE SEL, ALTN RTE SEL and CPNY T.O REQUEST.
steps.source: A380X MFD pages README of the aircraft repository (https://github.com/flybywiresim/aircraft/blob/master/fbw-a380x/src/systems/instruments/src/MFD/pages/README.md), table 'FMS: init'

mf_fpln.title: F-PLN page
mf_fpln.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'Understanding the FMS' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/); A380X Beginner Guide ch.5 Takeoff, Climb and Cruise, section '5. Cruise: Direct course to a waypoint (DIR TO)' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/05_takeoff-climb-cruise/); A380X Pilot Briefing, Keyboard Cursor Control Unit (KCCU), section 'F-PLN KEY; DEST KEY' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/kccu/)

steps.text: Scroll the plan with the arrow buttons at the bottom of the screen.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'Inputting a SID' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/)

steps.text: Click a waypoint to open its menu. The documented entries are AIRWAYS, INSERT NEXT WPT and DIR TO (FROM P.POS DIR TO).
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'En Route Flight Plan; DCT Before a Waypoint' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/); A380X Beginner Guide ch.5 Takeoff, Climb and Cruise, section '5. Cruise: Direct course to a waypoint (DIR TO)' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/05_takeoff-climb-cruise/)
steps.why: With INSERT NEXT WPT click the drop-down field, type the waypoint and press ENTER, without choosing from the list.

steps.text: Click the destination airport button at the bottom left to open the F-PLN / ARRIVAL page.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'Planning the Arrival' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/)

steps.text: TMPY F-PLN and INSERT TMPY *: a change first goes into a temporary flight plan (yellow). INSERT TMPY * at the bottom right makes it the active plan.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'Inputting a SID; Verify the Flight Plan' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/)
steps.why: On the ND, a temporary plan is a dashed yellow line and the active plan a solid green line.

steps.text: The DIR TO button at the bottom right opens the DIRECT TO page.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.5 Takeoff, Climb and Cruise, section '5. Cruise: Direct course to a waypoint (DIR TO)' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/05_takeoff-climb-cruise/)

steps.text: The VERT REV (vertical revision) page has a speed panel where you check or change the initial climb speed and the speed limit.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Taxi, Auto Flight System/Flight instrument: INITIAL CLIMB SPEED AND SPEED LIMIT' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf); A380X release notes v0140, section 'Changelog: speed limit modification on VERT REV SPD page' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/release-notes/a380x/v0140/)

steps.text: A HOLD page exists, but the docs give no steps for it. Waypoint names that exist more than once open a page that lists the options; pick the one you mean.
steps.source: A380X MFD pages README of the aircraft repository (https://github.com/flybywiresim/aircraft/blob/master/fbw-a380x/src/systems/instruments/src/MFD/pages/README.md), table 'FMS: f-pln-hold, f-pln-duplicate-names'; A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'Navaids: VOR Tuning' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/)

steps.text: Shown in the footer: the MSG LIST button, which opens the message list.
steps.source: A380X MFD common UI elements README (https://github.com/flybywiresim/aircraft/blob/master/fbw-a380x/src/systems/instruments/src/MFD/pages/common/README.md)

mf_deparr.title: DEPARTURE and ARRIVAL pages
mf_deparr.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'Inputting a SID; Planning the Arrival' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/)

steps.text: DEPARTURE page fields: RUNWAY drop-down, SID drop-down, TRANS drop-down (grey if none).
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'Inputting a SID' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/)

steps.text: Press TMPY F-PLN to put the departure into the temporary flight plan.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'Inputting a SID' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/)

steps.text: ARRIVAL page fields: RUNWAY, APPR, VIA, STAR and TRANS (grey if none).
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'Planning the Arrival' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/)
steps.why: A Y or Z behind the approach name only separates two approaches to the same runway.

steps.text: Press TMPY F-PLN, then INSERT TMPY * on the F-PLN page.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'Planning the Arrival; Verify the Flight Plan' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/)

mf_airdir.title: AIRWAYS and DIR TO pages
mf_airdir.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'En Route Flight Plan' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/); A380X Beginner Guide ch.5 Takeoff, Climb and Cruise, section '5. Cruise: Direct course to a waypoint (DIR TO)' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/05_takeoff-climb-cruise/)

steps.text: AIRWAYS page: click the VIA field, type the airway, ENTER; click the TO field, type the waypoint, ENTER. A new VIA / TO line appears.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'En Route Flight Plan' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/)

steps.text: Press TMPY F-PLN to load the airways into the temporary flight plan.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'En Route Flight Plan' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/)

steps.text: The AIRWAYS page also accepts DCT (direct) since release v0.14.0.
steps.source: A380X release notes v0140, section 'Changelog: Add DCT capability to AIRWAYS page' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/release-notes/a380x/v0140/)

steps.text: DIRECT TO page: type the waypoint if it is not in the plan, then press INSERT DIR TO* at the bottom right.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.5 Takeoff, Climb and Cruise, section '5. Cruise: Direct course to a waypoint (DIR TO)' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/05_takeoff-climb-cruise/)
steps.why: The page also gives the distance to the waypoint. Direct with abeam and course in/out are listed as missing in the README.

mf_perf.title: PERF page
mf_perf.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'Performance' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/); FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Flight Management System Initialization; Descent Preparation' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)

steps.text: The PERF page has tabs along the top. The docs name the panels T.O, CLB, CRZ, DES, APPR and GA. Use the KCCU PERF key for the page of the active phase.
steps.source: A380X MFD common UI elements README (https://github.com/flybywiresim/aircraft/blob/master/fbw-a380x/src/systems/instruments/src/MFD/pages/common/README.md); A380X Pilot Briefing, Keyboard Cursor Control Unit (KCCU), section 'PERF KEY' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/kccu/); FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Flight Management System Initialization, Climb performance; Descent Preparation' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)

steps.text: T.O PERF: V1, VR, V2; TOGA or FLEX (with the flex temperature); FLAPS; THS FOR; PACKS; ANTI ICE; THR RED, ACCEL and EO ACCEL altitudes (set automatically); TRANS altitude; T.O SHIFT for a shorter available runway.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'Performance' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/)
steps.why: DERATED take-off is not supported on the A380X.

steps.text: CLB panel: select the derated climb if needed. PRESEL SPEEDS on the climb and cruise panels preselect speeds.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Flight Management System Initialization, Climb performance; Speed preselection' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)

steps.text: CRZ panel: the cruise flight level. Check the optimum and maximum altitudes here.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Cruise; Climb, At 10 000 feet' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)

steps.text: DES panel: check the managed speed; type another speed in the ECON field if needed. The default speed limit is 250 kt below 10 000 ft; change it on the VERT REV page.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Descent Preparation, FMS DES panel' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)

steps.text: APPR panel: QNH, TEMP, MAG WIND, TRANS LVL, minimum (BARO for DA/MDA, RADIO for DH; NO DH options exist), landing configuration FLAPS 3 or FULL; ACTIVATE APPR * button.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.6 Descent, section 'Arrival Planning: Entering DEST DATA on the MFD' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/06_descent/); FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Descent Preparation, FMS APPR panel' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf); A380X Beginner Guide ch.7 Approach and ILS Landing, section 'APPR Phase and Speed' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/07_landing/); A380X release notes v0140, section 'Changelog: NO DH/NODH/NONE/NO' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/release-notes/a380x/v0140/)
steps.why: The message ENTER DEST DATA reminds you. A TL indication on the page shows a tailwind.

steps.text: GA panel: check the thrust reduction and acceleration altitudes of the go-around.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Descent Preparation, GA panel' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)

mf_fuel.title: FUEL&LOAD page
mf_fuel.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'Fuel & Payload' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/); A380X Fuel and Weight, section 'Cold and Dark Startup' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/aircraft/a380x/feature-guides/loading-fuel-weight/)

steps.text: Open it with the FUEL&LOAD button on the INIT page.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'Fuel & Payload: How and Where' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/)

steps.text: Fields: ZFW, ZFWCG, BLOCK, TAXI, PAX NBR, CI, RTE RSV (grey), ALTN, FINAL, MIN FUEL AT DEST, and TOW (the take-off weight, used by the performance calculator). Values are in tonnes with one decimal.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'Fuel & Payload: How and Where' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/); FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Flight Management System Initialization, Fuel and payload' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)
steps.why: Not available yet: correct fuel calculation and FUEL PLANNING (README).

steps.text: Complete this page before you start an engine.
steps.source: A380X Fuel and Weight, section 'Cold and Dark Startup' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/aircraft/a380x/feature-guides/loading-fuel-weight/)
steps.why: Otherwise INITIALIZE WEIGHT/CG shows in amber.

mf_wind.title: WIND page
mf_wind.source: A380X SimBrief and Navigraph Integration, section 'Wind Request' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/aircraft/a380x/feature-guides/simbrief/); FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Flight Management System Initialization, Winds predictions' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)

steps.text: Open the WIND page. Enter the forecast winds, or press CPNY WIND REQUEST at the bottom of the page.
steps.source: A380X SimBrief and Navigraph Integration, section 'Wind Request' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/aircraft/a380x/feature-guides/simbrief/)

steps.text: When the scratchpad message COMPANY WIND RECEIVED WAITING FOR INSERTION IN (ACTIVE or SEC X) shows, press RECEIVED CPNY WIND and INSERT.
steps.source: A380X SimBrief and Navigraph Integration, section 'Wind Request' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/aircraft/a380x/feature-guides/simbrief/)

steps.text: If RECEIVED COMPANY WIND DATA NOT VALID shows, enter the winds by hand.
steps.source: A380X SimBrief and Navigraph Integration, section 'Wind Request' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/aircraft/a380x/feature-guides/simbrief/)

mf_pos.title: POSITION pages
mf_pos.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Flight Management System Initialization; Descent Preparation; Initial Approach' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf); A380X release notes v2020150, section 'Headline Features: FMS Improvements' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/release-notes/a380x/v2020150/)

steps.text: POSITION / IRS: check that the IRS are aligned or in alignment.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Flight Management System Initialization, Inertial Reference System' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)

steps.text: POSITION / NAVAIDS: check the tuned VOR, ILS and ADF; deselect a navaid that NOTAMs say is unavailable. The TUNED FOR DISPLAY panel lets you clear tuned navaids. VOR1 and LS have IDENT fields.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Flight Management System Initialization, Navaids; Climb, At 10 000 feet' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf); A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'Navaids' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/)
steps.why: ADF input fields are listed as missing in the README.

steps.text: POSITION / MONITOR: check the navigation accuracy and the required navigation performance for the phase of flight.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Initial Approach, Navigation accuracy' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf); A380X release notes v2020150, section 'Changelog: Implement Position Monitor page' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/release-notes/a380x/v2020150/)

mf_sec.title: SEC INDEX
mf_sec.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Keyboard Cursor Control Unit (KCCU), section 'SEC INDEX KEY' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/kccu/); FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Flight Plan Preparation, Secondary flight plan' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf); A380X release notes v2020150, section 'Headline Features, Secondary Flight Plans' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/release-notes/a380x/v2020150/)

steps.text: Press the SEC INDEX key to open the SEC INDEX page.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Keyboard Cursor Control Unit (KCCU), section 'SEC INDEX KEY' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/kccu/)

steps.text: Use a secondary flight plan to prepare a runway change, an immediate return or a landing at the nearest airport. Delete old secondary plans first.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Flight Plan Preparation, Secondary flight plan' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)
steps.why: Secondary flight plans are fully supported in the FMS and on the ND since release v2020.15.0. The 'transfer to mailbox' function is missing (README).

steps.text: Activate it on the active flight plan page when needed. Set the minimum and the navaids again after the change.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Go-Around, To divert to the alternate; Descent Preparation, SEC pages' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)

mf_data.title: DATA pages
mf_data.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'Data & Status' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/); FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Flight Management System Initialization, Aircraft status' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf); A380X release notes v0140, section 'Changelog: RETURN button to DATA/AIRPORT page' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/release-notes/a380x/v0140/)

steps.text: DATA / STATUS: the first page of the FMS. It shows the aircraft type, the engine type, the navigation database serial number and dates, and the pilot stored waypoints, routes, navaids and runways.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.3 Preparing the FMS, section 'Data & Status' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/03_preparing-fms/)
steps.why: Verify the engine type, aircraft type and that the database is valid (SOP).

steps.text: DATA / AIRPORT: airport data, with a RETURN button. Pilot stored runways are missing.
steps.source: A380X release notes v0140, section 'Changelog: Add RETURN button to DATA/AIRPORT page' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/release-notes/a380x/v0140/); A380X MFD pages README of the aircraft repository (https://github.com/flybywiresim/aircraft/blob/master/fbw-a380x/src/systems/instruments/src/MFD/pages/README.md), table 'FMS: data/airport'

steps.text: DATA / ROUTE, NAVAID, WAYPOINT and PRINTER pages are not started yet, although the SOP mentions a route summary.
steps.source: A380X MFD pages README of the aircraft repository (https://github.com/flybywiresim/aircraft/blob/master/fbw-a380x/src/systems/instruments/src/MFD/pages/README.md), table 'FMS: data/route'

mf_surv.title: SURV page
mf_surv.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.2 Cockpit Preparation, section 'Pedestal: MFD Surveillance Default Settings' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/02_cockpit-preparation/); A380X Pilot Briefing, Surveillance Panel (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/surveillance/)

steps.text: Open SURV. Check the transponder: AUTO. Click SQWK, type the squawk code, ENTER, then click AUTO.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.2 Cockpit Preparation, section 'Pedestal: MFD Surveillance Default Settings' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/02_cockpit-preparation/)

steps.text: Check TCAS: TA/RA and NORM. All TAWS modes ON. G/S MODE: AUTO is the default (on the pedestal panel, AUTO sets the G/S MODE button ON, OFF turns the mode off).
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.2 Cockpit Preparation, section 'Pedestal: MFD Surveillance Default Settings' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/02_cockpit-preparation/); A380X Pilot Briefing, Surveillance Panel, section 'G/S MODE pb' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/surveillance/)

steps.text: The weather radar settings (WXR AUTO, tilt, gain, TURB, WX ON VD, PRED W/S) exist on the page, but the weather radar is inoperative in the A380X.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.2 Cockpit Preparation, section 'Pedestal: MFD Surveillance Default Settings' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/02_cockpit-preparation/); A380X Pilot Briefing, Surveillance Panel, section 'WXR Controls (INOP)' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/surveillance/)

steps.text: The WXR/TAWS SYS 1(2) and XPDR/TCAS SYS 1(2) buttons are on SURV / STATUS & SWITCHING and follow the pedestal buttons. That page is not started yet.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Surveillance Panel, section 'WXR/TAWS SYS 1(2) pb' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/surveillance/); A380X MFD pages README of the aircraft repository (https://github.com/flybywiresim/aircraft/blob/master/fbw-a380x/src/systems/instruments/src/MFD/pages/README.md), table 'SURV'

mf_atc.title: ATC COM pages
mf_atc.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Pedestal / Air Traffic Control Communication' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf); A380X INOP systems, section 'ATA 22 Flight Management System' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/aircraft/a380x/inop/)

steps.text: ATC COM / MSG RECORD: erase all the old CPDLC messages before the flight.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Air Traffic Control Communication: MESSAGE RECORD ERASE ALL' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)

steps.text: ATC COM / CONNECT / CONNECTION STATUS: if ADS services are expected, check that ADS is armed.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Air Traffic Control Communication: ADS CHECK ARMED' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)

steps.text: ATC and data link are listed as not implemented in the FMS, so these pages may not work.
steps.source: A380X INOP systems, section 'ATA 22 Flight Management System: ATC / datalink' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/aircraft/a380x/inop/)

mf_msg.title: FMS messages
mf_msg.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Keyboard Cursor Control Unit (KCCU), section 'CLR INFO KEY' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/kccu/); A380X MFD common UI elements README (https://github.com/flybywiresim/aircraft/blob/master/fbw-a380x/src/systems/instruments/src/MFD/pages/common/README.md)

steps.text: Read the message in the FMS message area. Press CLR INFO on the KCCU to clear it.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Keyboard Cursor Control Unit (KCCU), section 'CLR INFO KEY' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/kccu/)
steps.why: Messages are also kept in the message list (MSG LIST button in the footer). The README says the messages are not removed by themselves when their condition stops.

steps.text: INITIALIZE WEIGHT/CG (amber): the FUEL&LOAD page was not completed before an engine start.
steps.source: A380X Fuel and Weight, section 'Cold and Dark Startup' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/aircraft/a380x/feature-guides/loading-fuel-weight/)

steps.text: CHECK WEIGHT (amber): the gross weight calculated from the aerodynamics and the one from your ZFW and the fuel differ by more than 7 tonnes.
steps.source: A380X Fuel and Weight, section 'Cold and Dark Startup' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/aircraft/a380x/feature-guides/loading-fuel-weight/)

steps.text: ENTER DEST DATA: fill in the destination data on the PERF APPR page.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.6 Descent, section 'Arrival Planning: Entering DEST DATA on the MFD' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/06_descent/)

steps.text: NO FLS FOR THIS APPR: the selected approach has no FMS landing system (FLS) function, so it is a non-precision approach. FLS is not implemented in the A380X.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Descent Preparation, Flight Management System' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf); A380X Overview / Quick FAQ, section 'What approaches can be flown' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/aircraft/a380x/)

steps.text: CHECK APPR SEL: on a non-precision approach you inserted an ILS frequency by hand.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Precision Approach, APPR mode activation' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)

steps.text: NAV ACCUR DOWNGRADED: change the approach strategy.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Initial Approach, Navigation accuracy' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)

steps.text: NOT IN DATABASE, AWY/WPT MISMATCH, NOT ALLOWED: the route does not fit the nav data cycle of the sim.
steps.source: Known Issues (common to A32NX and A380X), section 'Nav Data Issues' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/aircraft/support/known-issues/known-issues-common/)

steps.text: UPLINK INSERT IN PROG, RECEIVED CPNY F-PLN, NOT TRANSMITTED TO ACR, COMPANY WIND RECEIVED..., RECEIVED COMPANY WIND DATA NOT VALID: SimBrief messages.
steps.source: A380X SimBrief and Navigraph Integration, section 'Using the FMS and SimBrief Integration' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/aircraft/a380x/feature-guides/simbrief/)

steps.text: CHECK MIN FUEL AT DEST and DEST EFOB BELOW MIN: added in release v0.14.0 with the amber EFOB; compare with MIN FUEL AT DEST on FUEL&LOAD. NAV PRIMARY and NAV PRIMARY LOST messages were added in the same release.
steps.source: A380X release notes v0140, section 'Changelog' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/release-notes/a380x/v0140/)

mf_pages.title: Pages that exist
mf_pages.text: According to the MFD README of the aircraft repository: finished (at least a first version) are INIT, FUEL&LOAD, PERF, F-PLN, DEPARTURE, ARRIVAL, AIRWAYS, DIRECT-TO, DUPLICATE NAMES, CPNY F-PLN REQ (SimBrief only), HOLD, VERT REV, FIX INFO, WIND, POSITION / IRS, NAVAIDS, MONITOR, SEC INDEX, DATA / STATUS, DATA / AIRPORT, the message list, ATC COM connect / msg record / D-ATIS and SURV / CONTROLS. Not started: RTE SEL, OFFSET, ALTERNATE, CLOSEST AIRPORTS, CPNY WIND DATA REQ, T.O data requests, equitime point, lat/long crossing, POSITION / GNSS, REPORT, TIME, DATA / NAVAID, WAYPOINT, ROUTE, PRINTER, ATC request / report pages, SURV / STATUS & SWITCHING and the FCU BKUP pages. (The beginner guide says FIX INFO is not implemented yet; the README says it is.) The README can be older or newer than your installed version.
mf_pages.source: A380X MFD pages README of the aircraft repository (https://github.com/flybywiresim/aircraft/blob/master/fbw-a380x/src/systems/instruments/src/MFD/pages/README.md), table 'FMS, ATCCOM, SURV and FCU BKUP'

ts_what.title: Troubleshooting

choices.label: The aircraft will not move, accelerate or steer
A switch, knob or control does not respond
flyPad, fuel, boarding or ground services
A feature seems to be missing
Low frame rate, crash or install problem
I want to report a bug

ts_what.help: Most problems reported to FlyByWire are caused by other add-ons or liveries in the Community folder, by wrong simulator settings or by missing throttle calibration. Start with the question that fits best; the sim answers some questions itself.
ts_what.source: Known Issues (common to A32NX and A380X), section 'Solutions to Commonly Reported Issues' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/aircraft/support/known-issues/known-issues-common/); Support Guide, section '2. How to Troubleshoot' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/aircraft/support/)

ts_eng_apu.title: Engines: air
ts_eng_apu.text: Is the APU available (AVAIL light) with the APU bleed ON?
ts_eng_apu.help: The A380 needs pressurised air to start the engines. The APU usually provides it.
ts_eng_apu.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.4 Engine Start and Taxi, section 'Engine Start: Note: Bleed Air' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/04_engine-start-taxi/)

ts_eng_air.title: Get air for the start
ts_eng_air.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.4 Engine Start and Taxi, section 'Engine Start: Note: Bleed Air' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/04_engine-start-taxi/); A380X Pilot Briefing, Air Panel, section 'APU BLEED pb-sw' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/ovhd/air/)

steps.text: Start the APU: APU MASTER SW ON, then APU START, and wait for AVAIL.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.2 Cockpit Preparation, section 'Fire Tests and APU Startup' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/02_cockpit-preparation/)

steps.text: Press APU BLEED so that it is ON.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Air Panel, section 'APU BLEED pb-sw' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/ovhd/air/)
steps.why: The APU bleed valve opens only when the APU runs, the aircraft is below 22 500 ft and there is no APU leak. If the APU BLEED FAULT light shows, the ECAM has detected a bleed leak.

steps.text: Alternatively, connect a ground air starter unit (ASU) on the flyPad Ground page.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.4 Engine Start and Taxi, section 'Engine Start: Note: Bleed Air' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/04_engine-start-taxi/)
steps.why: Do not use the APU bleed when a high-pressure ground air unit is connected; if the SD bleed page shows pressure, one is connected.

steps.text: If the engine start still lacks pressure, update the aircraft.
steps.source: A380X release notes v0140, section 'Changelog: [A380X/APU] Fix too low APU BLEED pressure during engine starts' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/release-notes/a380x/v0140/)
steps.why: A bug of low APU bleed pressure during the engine start was fixed in release v0.14.0.

ts_eng_sel.title: Engines: selector
ts_eng_sel.text: Is the ENG START selector at IGN START?

auto.code: (A:TURB ENG IGNITION SWITCH EX1:1, Enum) (A:TURB ENG IGNITION SWITCH EX1:2, Enum) + (A:TURB ENG IGNITION SWITCH EX1:3, Enum) + (A:TURB ENG IGNITION SWITCH EX1:4, Enum) +

ts_eng_sel.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Engine Start Panel, section 'ENG MODE selector' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/ovhd/eng-start/); A380X Pilot Briefing, Engine Master Panel, section 'ENGINE MASTER LEVER' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/engine-master/)

ts_eng_ign.title: Set the selector
ts_eng_ign.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Engine Master Panel, section 'ENGINE 1(2)(3)(4) MASTER LEVER' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/engine-master/)

steps.text: Set the ENG START selector to IGN START.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Engine Start Panel, section 'ENG MODE selector' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/ovhd/eng-start/)
steps.why: The engine master only starts the engine automatically when the selector is at IGN START. The CRANK position is not available in the A380X.

check.code: (A:TURB ENG IGNITION SWITCH EX1:1, Enum) (A:TURB ENG IGNITION SWITCH EX1:2, Enum) + (A:TURB ENG IGNITION SWITCH EX1:3, Enum) + (A:TURB ENG IGNITION SWITCH EX1:4, Enum) +

steps.text: Wait about 10 seconds for the engine page on the SD.
steps.source: A380X Beginner Guide ch.4 Engine Start and Taxi, section 'Engine Start: ENGINE START selector' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-beginner-guide/04_engine-start-taxi/)
steps.why: The wait lets the engine tests run.

ts_eng_m.title: Engine masters
ts_eng_m.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Engine Master Panel, section 'Usage' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/engine-master/); FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Engine Start' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)

steps.text: Put all thrust levers at IDLE.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'When Cleared for Start, Thrust levers settings' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)
steps.why: A lever beyond the idle detent can damage the engine at start-up.

steps.text: Wait for the amber crosses and messages to go away on the engine parameters of the EWD and the SD engine page, then set the engine master ON.
steps.source: FlyByWire A380X SOP PDF (3 Dec 2021), section 'Engine Start: ENGINE MASTER 1, then 2 ON' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/assets/sop/FBW_A380X_SOP.pdf)

steps.text: If the engine master FAULT light (amber) comes on, set that master OFF and start again.
steps.source: A380X Pilot Briefing, Engine Master Panel, section 'ENGINE MASTER LIGHT; ENGINE MASTER LEVER' (https://docs.flybywiresim.com/pilots-corner/a380x/a380x-briefing/flight-deck/pedestal/engine-master/)
steps.why: FAULT means that an automatic start aborted, or that the HP fuel valve position is abnormal (ENG HP FUEL VLV FAULT), or that the overthrust protection has shut the engine down (ENG CTL SYS FAULT). Setting the master to OFF aborts the start and resets the FADEC.
